serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Fuck it… I don’t know exactly why, but I don’t want her to destroy my sexbot!
You: Ok, I got it! Just come at me bitch!
!!!
She plunged towards me faster than before! I don’t think I can dodge her!
You: Help me!
As I called for help I saw a shadow moving from behind my attacker. 
???: Ugh!
It’s {f_botName}! As soon as this knife-wielding whore lost {f_botName} from her sight, she got up and snuck up from behind to give her a chop to the neck!
???: W-who w-wazzzit? *bump*
She… She lost consciousness and her head made a loud *bump* as it dropped to the ground!
Bot: You said that no one can see me, so I waited until she lost me from her sight.
You: Thanks! I thought I was a goner! But how come you can attack humans? What about Asimov’s laws?
Bot: Asimov’s laws? What’s that?
You: N-never mind, we will talk about this later. 
You: Now we need to get this bitch out of here!
